data.gender_notes: Quraishi is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Quraishi is an Islamic name that means 'descendant of Quraish'. The Quraish were a tribe that lived in Mecca, Saudi Arabia and were the guardians of the Kaaba. Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) belonged to the Quraish tribe. The name Quraishi carries the meaning “Descendant of Quraish” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Quraishi usually hope their child will grow to embody descendant of quraish and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Being a descendant of the noble Quraish tribe, a Quraishi is expected to uphold the high moral and ethical values associated with the tribe.
data.etymology: Quraishi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Descendant of Quraish.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Quraishi total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
